blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa claimed that the Philippine National Police (PNP) has no basis for its manhunt operations as the senator is not listed in the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) red notice. Lawyer Israelito Torreon, the senator’s legal counsel, insisted that, based on information they received, there is no Interpol red notice yet against dela Rosa. An Interpol red notice is a request, which allows all law enforcement agencies to locate and provisionally arrest a person pending extradition and other legal proceedings. “May na-confirm nga ‘yung isang kasama natin na wala pala siya […]...
